name: Crowned Council Hall
mapPosition: 12 o'clock on the outer wall, crowning the line between the Aurorus and Glass wedges
environment: A neutral fortified council complex overlooking the city axis, containing the Sixfold chamber, civic offices, and the guarded rooms holding the wounded First Speaker.

name: Guarded Central Avenue
mapPosition: Straight neutral axis from the Crowned Council Hall to the northern containment gate
environment: A secured civic corridor separating the Glass and Aurorus edges, kept open for council movement, emergency crews, containment forces, and controlled transport.

name: Tear Containment Ring
mapPosition: Concentric fortified ring at the exact center of Velmora
environment: A hybrid containment fortress with a heavy inner wall, one controlled gate facing each faction wedge, a guarded circulation road, and magical anchor towers reinforcing the barrier around the Tear.

name: Aurorus Wedge
environment: Midnight-blue towers, violet conduit light, pale-gold fittings, sealed archives, observatories, and the Starvault define a guarded center of magical power and scholarship.

name: Chrysalis Wedge
environment: Bone-ivory clinics, amber glass, moss-toned medicinal gardens, humid recovery courts, and the Chrysalis Conservatory make alteration visibly part of daily life.

name: Thorn Wedge
environment: Ox-blood banners, thorn-green markings, black-iron defenses, kennels, hunt yards, reinforced roofs, and Thorn Bastion prepare the ward for the next beast alarm.

name: Wayfarer Wedge
environment: Rust, weathered teal, canvas awnings, sorting yards, test sheds, caravans, and the Patchwork Exchange form a district rebuilt from useful pieces of impossible places.

name: Hands Wedge
environment: Brick, ochre, warm plaster, dense housing, kitchens, cisterns, repair yards, markets, and the Common Forge make this the loud practical heart of everyday survival.

name: Glass Wedge
environment: Smoke-gray stone, mirror-silver details, cold-blue glass, quiet lanes, evidence vaults, watchrooms, and the Glass Archive create a district that observes more than it reveals.
